criteria.prompt: Borrower tidak blacklisted dan tidak watchlisted
criteria.notes: Samakan dengan Django admin ID loanapplication changeview → User and Profile Details (bukan re-match live ke blacklist/watchlist tables). Logic core-loans: borrower_is_blacklisted = profile.is_blacklisted() = taggit tag exact name 'APPUPT' in profile.tags; borrower_is_watchlisted = profile.is_in_watchlist() = tag exact name 'PPATK' (lihat users/models/impls/id.py BaseIdProfileChecker.is_blacklisted; checkers di users/models/id_profile.py; admin di loans/admin/views/id_loan_application_child_admin.py). Query Metabase: loans_loanapplication.borrower_id → users_profile.user_id → EXISTS taggit_taggeditem+taggit_tag.name IN ('APPUPT','PPATK') pada object_id=profile.id (lihat field-hints). Tag method seperti APPUPT:FM / PPATK:FN+DOB TIDAK menggantikan base tag untuk flag admin. datetime_profile_check = users_profile.datetime_profile_check (konteks last check). Jika SALAH SATU true/Yes → fail (hard reject). Keduanya false/No → pass. Flag tidak bisa di-resolve → insufficient_data.

criteria.prompt: Penghasilan minimal ≥ Rp 3.000.000 (borrower income jika self guaranteed; selain itu guarantor income)
criteria.notes: Jika loan app self guaranteed → pakai borrower monthly income. Selain itu → pakai guarantor monthly income. Bandingkan dengan 3000000 IDR. Income null/missing → insufficient_data.

Samakan dengan Django admin ID loanapplication changeview → Loan Information Notes → Underwriting Rating (IdUnderwritingLoanAppFieldset; display via LoanApplicationChildAdmin.underwriting_rating_with_status → get_underwriting_display()['rating'] dari loans/mixins/loan_underwriting.py). Nilai tersimpan: loans_loanapplication.underwriting_rating (biasanya R1–R10). Allow: R1,R2,R3,R4,R5,R6,R7 → pass. Hard fail/reject: R8,R9,R10. Normalisasi: jika admin menampilkan prefix A/M (prefs underwriter_display), treat A8/M8 sama seperti R8 (bandingkan angka rating 1–10). Rating null/kosong/'-' → insufficient_data. Jangan invent rating dari decision text saja.

criteria.prompt: Pekerjaan pihak relevan bukan TNI/POLRI/pengacara/jurnalis/collection agency/keamanan
criteria.notes: Pihak: guarantor_type == 'Self Guaranteed' → borrower; selain itu → guarantor (sama seperti income/DBR). Baca employment_status, industry, position dari loan application (admin: Borrower Income Information / guarantor income fields). Field core-loans: borrower_employment_status / guarantor_employment_status (FK users.EmploymentStatus), borrower_industry / guarantor_industry (FK users.EmploymentIndustry), borrower_position / guarantor_position (free text); lihat loans/mixins/loan_profile_info.py + loans/mixins/loan_guarantor.py + loans/models/loan_application.py. Hard fail jika SALAH SATU field pihak relevan match kategori terlarang (fuzzy/case-insensitive): (1) TNI/militer — status 'Militer', teks TNI/tentara/militer, industry 'Pemerintah/Pertahanan'; (2) POLRI/polisi — status 'Polisi', teks POLRI/polisi, industry 'Keamanan/Penegakan Hukum' bila konteks polisi; (3) lawyer — status 'Pengacara / Notaris', industry 'Legal/Hukum', teks pengacara/advokat/notaris/lawyer; (4) journalist — industry 'Hiburan/Media/Jurnalisme', teks jurnalis/wartawan/journalist; (5) collection agency — teks collection/debt collector/penagihan/agency penagihan pada position/status/industry; (6) security — status 'Pengamanan', industry 'Keamanan/Penegakan Hukum', teks satpam/security/keamanan/pengamanan. Kutip field+nilai yang memicu. Semua status+industry+position pihak relevan kosong → insufficient_data. Tidak ada match → pass.

criteria.prompt: Memiliki riwayat kredit FDC dengan nomor HP yang cocok (escalate CLIK manual jika FDC Not Found)
criteria.notes: Pakai canonical FDC fact query di field-hints (filter inquiries_idinquirydata.loan_application_id + kind dulu; JANGAN andalkan M2M join saja). Log: inquiries_idinquirylog Found/Not Found/Failed. Pihak HP: Self Guaranteed → users_user.username; selain itu → guarantor_mobile_number. FDC HP: IdInquiryData.mobile_number (kind=pihak). Normalisasi +62/62/0. Found + semua HP FDC non-kosong match → pass. Found + ada mismatch → soft fail; evidence WAJIB kutip sumber HP pihak, jumlah baris match vs mismatch, dan HP FDC distinct (mask sebagian). Found + HP FDC semua kosong ATAU HP pihak hilang → insufficient_data. Found tapi query fasilitas gagal/error → JANGAN anggap data hilang; retry canonical SQL lalu escalate + confidence low jika tetap gagal. Not Found → insufficient_data + minta user cek CLIK manual (jangan query CLIK); saran prefer escalate. Failed → insufficient_data (retry FDC). Phone mismatch TIDAK boleh menghalangi fetch/evaluasi DPD & written-off.

criteria.prompt: Active loan dengan DPD = 0 (berlaku untuk FDC)
criteria.notes: Hanya status_pinjaman = 'Agreement Activated'. Worst current_dpd harus = 0. 0 baris active setelah fetch sukses → not_applicable. Log = Found ⇒ fasilitas diharapkan: jika query gagal/kosong tak terduga, RETRY canonical SQL (field-hints); jangan publish insufficient_data seolah DPD tidak ada — escalate + confidence low. Log = Not Found → not_applicable + minta CLIK manual. Log = Failed → insufficient_data.

criteria.prompt: Closed loan dengan DPD max ≤ 30 hari (berlaku untuk FDC)
criteria.notes: Hanya status_pinjaman = 'Closed' (bukan Written Off). Worst max_dpd ≤ 30. 0 closed setelah fetch sukses → not_applicable. Log = Found ⇒ sama seperti active: query gagal ≠ insufficient_data final; retry lalu escalate. Not Found → not_applicable + CLIK manual. Failed → insufficient_data. Written Off dievaluasi kriteria terpisah.

criteria.prompt: Tidak ada fasilitas FDC Written Off / Written Off Closed
criteria.notes: Hard reject jika ada baris IdInquiryData pihak relevan dengan status_pinjaman IN ('Written Off','Written Off Closed') — mapping AFPI W/F/S di inquiries/models.py convert_status_pinjaman. Kutip jumlah WO, worst max_dpd/current_dpd, outstanding. 0 WO setelah fetch sukses → pass. Log = Found tapi query gagal → retry canonical SQL; jangan insufficient_data palsu; escalate jika tetap gagal. Log = Not Found → not_applicable (bukan pass). Log = Failed → insufficient_data. Jangan anggap WO sebagai Closed.

Samakan rumus core-loans IdLoanApplication (bukan kolom DB). Admin: Auto Approve Indicator → Debt burden ratio (id_loan_application_child_admin.debt_burden_ratio). Pihak: guarantor_type == 'Self Guaranteed' → borrower_debt_burden_ratio; selain itu → guarantor_debt_burden_ratio (loans/models/id_loan_application.py). Numerator: Σ loans_loan.approved_monthly_repayment untuk Loan.objects.active() status IN ('Agreement Activated','Written Off','For Pre Termination') di mana KTP pihak match sebagai borrower ATAU guarantor pada loans_idloanapplication, exclude aplikasi ini, lalu + (approved_monthly_repayment OR requested_monthly_repayment) aplikasi ini. Jika KTP pihak kosong → bagian active = 0. Denominator: verified_monthly_income OR monthly_income pihak (core memakai or 1 untuk hindari div/0; untuk Decision Notes jika income hilang dan tidak ada DBR admin → insufficient_data, jangan pakai 1). Jangan pakai profile.total_active_installment / requested_total_monthly_payment. Utamakan nilai DBR admin jika di-paste. Active loans kosong di warehouse → Σ active = 0 (bukan insufficient_data). Ambang pack tetap DBR < 50%; kutip juga max_dbr_deviation / is_within_max_dbr_deviation (Auto Approve: DBR <= max dari DebtBurdenRatioDeviationTier) sebagai konteks.

criteria.prompt: Termasuk dalam partner prioritas (Formal: UBSI, UNINUS, Universitas Presiden, Cakrawala, IDS, LSPR, UNM, Universitas Siber Indonesia / Cyber University; Non Formal: dibimbing, RevoU kecuali product SNPL, Hacktiv8, MIHCA, EF, WSE)
criteria.notes: Formal allowlist: UBSI, UNINUS, Universitas Presiden, Cakrawala, IDS, LSPR, UNM, Universitas Siber Indonesia (Cyber University). Non Formal allowlist: dibimbing, RevoU (kecuali product SNPL), Hacktiv8, MIHCA, EF, WSE. Cocokkan nama partner secara fuzzy (singkatan vs nama panjang). RevoU + SNPL = fail kriteria ini.
